title: New Tier opens a page, not a dialog, with the name ready to type
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Note how many active tiers the Tiers list shows (for example 6).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the active tiers.

Step 2:

  • A page opens, not a dialog.
  • The name field is empty with the cursor in it.
  • The hint under it reads "New tiers go last, as Tier 7." (6 active + 1 = 7).
  • Cancel and Create Tier show.
  • The matrix list shows every matrix, with no checkboxes and no Set Rule.
